entries.title: Activity shows one line per merge, under the task's key
entries.body: A merge now writes one line in Activity, under its task's key: it says Merging #709 while it runs and becomes Merged #709 on GitHub, or Cannot merge with the reason. Lines no longer carry web addresses, a finished report writes no line of its own, and your choice on a card reads You chose. On your iPhone and iPad, Activity shows each line on one row with the newest at the bottom, follows new lines like a chat, opens a line's summary when you tap it and opens the task's record when you tap its key.
